findings.current: Every citizen of the Great Nation has that right.
findings.defect: “Citizen” introduces a civic-status category that the Korean does not establish. 백성 refers to the people or subjects of the Great Nation, not specifically citizens.
findings.rationale: The source says 대국의 모든 백성들, meaning all the people or subjects of the Great Nation. The surrounding imperial setting does not establish a citizenship-based distinction.
findings.replacement: Everyone in the Great Nation has that right.

summary: The chapter is faithful overall, with one minor shift in how the petition right-holder is described.
